consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly praise the performance of the Grateful Dead at The Ark on April 23, 1969, highlighting the exceptional jamming and setlist. Many consider it one of the best shows of the era, with standout moments in songs like 'Dark Star' and 'He Was A Friend Of Mine.'
standout_songs: He Was A Friend Of Mine
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.4 for 58 reviews + 1.5 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm and high praise from multiple reviewers for the performance and setlist significantly elevate the sentiment from a neutral baseline.
